description: Operational weather for the Weather pack: DWD station observations with quality levels and location history, MOSMIX_L forecast issuances, DWD CAP warnings, aviationweather.gov METAR/TAF and station info, NWS gridpoint forecasts and alerts, and Open-Meteo runs (default-off, non-commercial). Bounded selections; published data only, never a Noesis forecast or advice. Every source is unverified-live until a dated run (WX14).
